relationships.subject: myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that myocardial I/R injury significantly upregulated TLR4 expression in the spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Upregulation of TLR4 exhibited functional crosstalk with the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, our findings reveal classic neuroinflammatory signals derived from TLR4 that contribute to neuronal hyperexcitation following myocardial I/R injury.

key_findings: Myocardial I/R upregulates TLR4 predominantly in spinal dorsal horn neurons.
Inhibiting TLR4 reduced neuronal activity and attenuated myocardial ischemic injury.
